scope: Reproduce released aggregate polarization evidence; numerical linear-response and synthetic injection checks. No fresh strain likelihood or EFMW parameter inference.

pass_gates.published_rounded_numbers: All 36 central/error entries of Table 6 agree to two decimal places
pass_gates.projection_algebra: Symmetry, idempotence and tensor annihilation each below 1e-12
pass_gates.synthetic_noise_and_power: Each arm within five binomial standard errors of analytic probability
pass_gates.coupling_identity: 1000 stable F>0 examples: matrix inverse agrees with closed form within 1e-12

interpretation: These are reproducibility and numerical-consistency gates, not discovery criteria. Published data were inspected before this protocol; this is not a preregistered discovery analysis. Simulation seed and checks fixed before first simulation execution.
